Omar Abdullah Meets Amit Shah, Discusses J&K Statehood Restoration

Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah met Union Home Minister Amit Shah in New Delhi on Friday evening. Abdullah discussed issues concerning the Union Territory, specifically pushing for the early restoration of J&K's statehood. He also raised matters related to public welfare during the meeting.
